title: Remove the impossible None branch from matched-count CSR row validation

gardener_decision.problem: The matched-count canonical CSR row-span path still carried a per-entry Optional sentinel branch even though valid column indices are necessarily non-negative.
gardener_decision.change: Use row-local integer sentinel -1, replace the impossible previous_column-is-not-None branch with a direct ordering comparison, and spell the valid-range check as item < 0 or item >= column_count.
gardener_decision.why_not_another_abstraction: The change stays inside the existing TypedRelationBlock constructor and introduces no helper, validator, cache, registry, backend, relation type, profiler schema, or benchmark harness.
gardener_decision.semantic_boundary: The existing type -> range -> common entry-count -> strict row ordering error precedence remains externally unchanged. A negative-index regression pins the sentinel boundary; count-mismatch inputs continue through the unchanged precedence-preserving fallback.
